subject: PlaneGeometry
question:
Henna has four hair ribbons of width $10 \mathrm{~cm}$. When she measures them, she finds that each ribbon is $25 \mathrm{~cm}$ longer than the next smallest ribbon. She then arranges the ribbons to form two different shapes as shown in the diagram. How much longer is the perimeter of the second shape than the perimeter of the first shape? <image1>
Choices:
A:$75 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$50 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$25 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$20 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:$0 \mathrm{~cm}$
